div.p: A new game. A new adventure. Let’s find your starting point.
Love strategy and collecting? Explore trading card games. Prefer a shared story? Try a role-playing game. Looking for a relaxed evening? Discover board games.
Tell us what you enjoy, who you’ll be playing with and your budget. Ask about starter options and current availability before choosing your first game.
Browse upcoming events and check the format, experience level and what to bring. Each event page includes its own registration details.

details.summary: Do I need experience to visit?
details.p: You can visit to browse and ask questions. If you want to join a session, contact the team to find an event suited to your experience.

details.summary: How do I enter a tournament?
details.p: Open Tournaments, select an event and review its details. Choose an available ticket, enter the attendee information and follow the checkout steps for paid entry.

details.summary: Where do I find rules and entry requirements?
details.p: Read the event description before registering. Contact the organiser if you need clarification about deck formats, equipment, age requirements or the event’s cancellation terms.
Browse the shop, choose your options and use the cart to checkout. Current prices, availability, payment methods and delivery options are shown in the shop and checkout.
